info.title: SohappyPDF API
info.description:
Public developer API for SohappyPDF file upload and asynchronous conversion.

Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`.
Never put API keys in URLs, browser JavaScript, or source control.

Conversions are asynchronous. Create a conversion, poll its status, then download the result file.
Temporary files expire after about 2 hours.
Presigned upload and download URLs expire after 900 seconds.

Plan defaults from the entitlement catalog:
- Free: 20 conversions/month, 500 MB storage, 20 MB max file, 30 API requests/minute.
- Pro: 500 conversions/month, 10 GB storage, 100 MB max file, 60 API requests/minute.

API key and billing management stay in the dashboard. They are not part of this public key-authenticated surface.
Developer webhooks are not available in this version.

servers.description: Local development. Replace the origin with your deployed API host. Do not invent a production domain.

apiKey.description: Dashboard-issued API key. Send `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`. Do not use query parameters.

ConversionType.description: Implemented types: pdf-to-word, pdf-to-jpg, pdf-to-png, pdf-to-txt, jpg-to-pdf, png-to-pdf, merge-pdf, split-pdf, compress-pdf.

post.description: Creates a pending file record and a short-lived PUT URL. Upload the bytes directly to that URL, then call complete.
